name: smwgraphics-popful-mail-snes-alcazar-castle-clouds
title: Popful Mail (SNES) - Alcazar Castle (Clouds)
description:
One of the backgrounds seen in the final level of Popful Mail for Super Famicom. A great fit for final castle levels or sky levels in general. The clouds also are perfect for fast parallaxing scrolling, so I recommend adding it for the best result.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
